Milliman is seeking a Software Developer to support its FRM Trading Technologies department. The role involves creating, maintaining, and enhancing global trading, risk, and back-office systems while collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Big Data
Consulting

Analytics

Responsibilities
Create, maintain, and enhance systems to support our growing business. This includes both client and server-side software, database, and potentially intranet-based web development
Take on responsibilities only limited by your abilities and work with a fair degree of independence
Work and communicate clearly with other technical and non-technical team members including traders

Required
Proficiency in C# and/or C/C++ (or comparable programming languages)
Working knowledge of software development life cycles
Familiarity with implementation of web APIs (HTTP/S protocol, REST, authentication, etc.)
Familiarity with relational database schema and efficient query construction
B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent degree
Excellent communication skills
Demonstration of consistent positive collaboration with peers and/or customers
Recognition and adherence to standards of professionalism (e.g., reliability, timeliness, courtesy, appropriate attire, etc.)
Preferred
Experience with financial markets, mutual funds, portfolio management, and derivatives
Experience coding complex projects in VBA
Knowledge of Git source control system
Understanding of SDLC
Source control systems and branching patterns
Multithreaded programming
History integrating with one or more cloud vendors (e.g., Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, etc.)
Familiarity with issue-tracking and related SDLC tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps, GitHub, etc.)
Exposure to programming environments common to insurance professionals (e.g., Excel and VBA, SAS, Python, etc.)
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
Candidates hired into this role will be required to work in-person in the Milliman office in Chicago, IL on a weekly basis, but flexible work arrangements will be considered
Benefits
Medical, Dental and Vision – Coverage for employees, dependents, and domestic partners.
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential support for personal and work-related challenges.
401(k) Plan – Includes a company matching program and profit-sharing contributions.
Discretionary Bonus Program – Recognizing employee contributions.
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) – Pre-tax savings for dependent care, transportation, and eligible medical expenses.
Paid Time Off (PTO) – Begins accruing on the first day of work. Full-time employees accrue 15 days per year, and employees working less than full-time accrue PTO on a prorated basis.
Holidays – A minimum of 10 paid holidays per year.
Family Building Benefits – Includes adoption and fertility assistance.
Paid Parental Leave – 11 weeks of paid leave for employees who meet eligibility criteria.
Life Insurance & AD&D – 100% of premiums covered by Milliman.
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability – Fully paid by Milliman.
Flexible work arrangements will be considered.
